description: This file contains action creators for team-related operations in a Mattermost web application, including adding/removing users from teams, switching teams, updating team order preferences, and fetching common teams for group messages.

methods.name: removeUserFromTeamAndGetStats
methods.description: Removes a user from a team, then fetches user info, team stats, and channel stats.

methods.name: addUserToTeamFromInvite
methods.description: Adds a user to a team via an invite token, then fetches the team and updates the team member state.

methods.name: addUserToTeam
methods.description: Adds a user to a team and updates the team member state.

methods.name: addUsersToTeam
methods.description: Adds multiple users to a team and updates channel stats.

methods.name: switchTeam
methods.description: Switches the current team by updating the URL or selecting the team directly.

methods.name: updateTeamsOrderForUser
methods.description: Updates the user's preferred order of teams.

methods.name: getGroupMessageMembersCommonTeams
methods.description: Fetches teams that are common among group message members in a specific channel.
